gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Pok Fu Lam Road near the south western corner of Chi Fu Fa Yuen running firstly in a northerly direction, then in a generally north-easterly direction and turning in a south-westerly direction for a total distance of approximately 1000 m until it joins with Pok Fu Lam Road at the south eastern corner of Chi Fu Fa Yuen; as shown coloured red on Drawing No. HH 3444.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點在置富花園西南角附近與薄扶林道會合，先向北伸展，後偏向東北再轉向西南至置富花園東南角與薄扶林道會合為止，全長約一千公尺，位置在 HH 3444 號圖則上用紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with the Chi Fu Road near the south-eastern corner of Chi Fu Fa Yuen running in a north-westerly direction, then turning in a southerly direction for a total distance of about 110 m and ending at the turning circle adjacent to the future school sites as shown coloured green on Drawing No. HH 3444.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路徑為盡頭路，起點在置富花園東南角附近與置富道會合，向西北伸展，後轉向南至日後興建學校地盆之迴旋處為終點，全長約一百一十公尺，位置在 HH 3444 號圖則上用綠色標明。
